name: Momentic
tagline: AI testing platform where an agent explores web, iOS and Android apps and turns approved flows into regression tests.
bestFor: Engineering teams that want AI-written tests stored as YAML in their repo
description: Momentic's agent, Mo, explores a web app or iOS/Android build, reports bugs and converts approved flows into tests that use natural-language element targets and AI actions. A Free plan includes $50 of usage a month, and the Scale plan is $500 a month as a prepaid usage balance.
pros: Free plan with $50 of usage per month, 5 concurrent browsers and no credit card
Usage-based pricing with no per-seat charges; test steps cost $0.0125 each
iOS simulator and Android emulator testing on all plans
SOC 2 Type II on all plans; Google SSO on all plans
cons: Paid self-serve plan starts at $500 per month
AI-generated and failure-recovery steps cost double ($0.025 per step), and triage/auto-healing calls cost $1.25 each
SAML SSO, SCIM and audit logs are Enterprise only
freePlanDetails: $50 of usage per month, no overages or top-ups, 5 concurrent browsers, 2 Android + 2 iOS, 30-day result retention; runs pause when the balance reaches $0

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Flat $0 per month per account; includes $50 of usage each month that does not roll over

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Flat $500 per month billed in advance as a usage balance; extra funds in $50-$1,000 top-ups that never expire; 25 concurrent browsers, 5 Android + 5 iOS; no annual price listed

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom test-based pricing; SAML SSO, SCIM, audit log, uptime SLA, 1-hour mobile sessions

name: QA Wolf
tagline: AI agents build, run and maintain Playwright and Appium tests, with an optional service where QA Wolf staff own the suite.
bestFor: Teams that want end-to-end coverage written and maintained by the vendor
description: QA Wolf's agents create, run and repair end-to-end tests for web, mobile and desktop apps, and tests export as open-source Playwright and Appium code. Pay-as-you-go runs cost $1 per 5-minute web run and $2 for mobile or desktop, while the managed Coverage-as-a-Service is quoted by sales.
pros: Published per-run price: $1 per 5-minute web run, $2 for mobile and desktop
No seat limits, no AI credits and parallel runs by default
Managed Coverage-as-a-Service with a stated 80%+ automated coverage guarantee
Tests export as open-source Playwright and Appium code
cons: Managed service pricing is quote-only
Monthly cost grows with run volume: the vendor's example of 50 web tests daily is $1,083 a month
API testing is not described on the site
trial: Free runs for new teams (amount not stated)

plans.name: Pay as you go
plans.notes: Billed per test run, not per month: $1 per 5-minute block for web and Linux Electron, $2 for mobile and desktop; up to 3 attempts per run billed once; optional monthly spending cap

plans.notes: QA Wolf writes the suite and your team runs it; quoted by sales

plans.name: Coverage-as-a-Service
plans.notes: QA Wolf writes, runs and maintains tests and investigates failures; 80%+ coverage guarantee; quoted by sales
